summary: Full regression pass (backend pytest + Playwright UI) after code-review refactors and Rudaya logo insertion. 21/22 backend tests pass; all UI regression scenarios pass (cookie-only auth survives reload/hard-refresh, logout + protected-route redirects, dashboard KPIs, transactions filters/search/date-range/CRUD/CSV, forecast upsert, project P&L, monthly, settings->drawer propagation, logos load). Only gap: no brute-force login lockout (playbook item) and edge proxy rewrites CORS headers to '*' on the public URL.

minor.issue: No brute-force protection/lockout. 6 consecutive wrong-password attempts all return 401 (expected 423/429 after 5). Playbook requires lockout.

response.delete_cookie('access_token', path='/') omits secure=True/samesite='none' used when setting the cookie. Browser deletion worked in Chromium, but attribute mismatch is fragile across browsers — mirror the set attributes on delete.

Preview edge proxy rewrites CORS to 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' and drops 'Allow-Credentials: true' on the public URL. App-level CORS is correct (verified on localhost:8001, echoes explicit origin + credentials). Credentialed XHR currently works in the preview because it is same-origin; a cross-origin production origin would be blocked by the edge. Informational.

issues: Date range inputs use the native browser date picker (type=date, mm/dd/yyyy US format) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover used elsewhere; inconsistent with the Indian date format shown in the table (YYYY-MM-DD). Same for txn-date in the drawer.
Logo PNG has an opaque white background box on the dark hero image — a transparent PNG or a padded white card would look cleaner.
Recharts logs repeated 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings on mount/route change; set an explicit minHeight/minWidth on the ResponsiveContainer parent.

action_items: Add login brute-force lockout (5 failed attempts -> 423/429 with cooldown) per auth playbook.
Match cookie attributes on logout delete_cookie (httponly/secure/samesite='none', path='/').
Optional: replace native date inputs with shadcn Calendar popover for consistency; add minHeight to chart containers.
critical_code_review_comments: get_current_user still accepts an Authorization Bearer header fallback; harmless but keep it intentional or drop it now that the frontend is cookie-only.
PUT /api/transactions/{id} and DELETE use ObjectId(txn_id) without validation — a malformed id raises bson InvalidId -> 500. Wrap in try/except and return 400/404.
No per-user scoping on transactions/forecast (single-tenant by design); document it if multi-user is planned.
seed_admin correctly re-hashes when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes and admin hash verified as $2b$ bcrypt.
seed_data_creation: Created and then removed: TEST_/QA_ project IDs, accounts and transactions (cleanup script run, 2 project_ids + 2 accounts deleted). NOTE: forecast for Jul-2026 was written during testing and now holds 3,500,000 (total forecast 2026 = 41,00,000) — restore the original value if it mattered.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (22 tests: auth cookie flow, CORS, bcrypt format, lockout, reports, txn CRUD, forecast upsert, meta). Only test_brute_force_lockout fails (feature not implemented). UI selects are radix (not <select>) — use click trigger + get_by_role('option') with force=True; date/search filters are debounced (~1.5s). Transactions table shows a placeholder row 'No transactions match your filters.' so count rows via table text check. Project P&L / charts need ~3-4s after route change before data renders.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional regressions from the refactor. Cookie-only auth verified: login sets httpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None access_token, localStorage stays empty, page reload and hard refresh on /transactions keep the session, logout clears the cookie and all six protected routes redirect to /login. Logos (/rudaya-logo.png) return 200 and render (naturalWidth 1134) in both sidebar and login page.
